papers.title: Minds and Molds: What Can Artificial Intelligence Do for Multi-Material Injection Molding
papers.venue: Journal of Mechanical Engineering and Manufacturing
papers.abstract: Multimaterial injection molding (MMIM) enables the integration of distinct polymer properties within a single component, but its tightly coupled thermal–rheological dynamics and interfacial phenomena complicate process control and quality assurance. Concurrently, advances in artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) are reshaping manufacturing through predictive modeling, adaptive optimization and data-driven control. This review critically synthesises AI/ML methods and adjacent optimisation and control frameworks relevant to MMIM, distinguishing learning-based predictive models from conventional statistical, surrogate-based, and simulation-assisted approaches. Within this framework, methods such as artificial neural networks, radial basis function models, genetic algorithms, hybrid intelligent optimisation, and sensor-integrated control strategies are mapped against key manufacturing challenges including weld lines, sink marks, short shots, warpage, burn marks, and flow marks. Evidence from 2010–2025 shows that AI can improve dimensional stability, defect prediction and parameter selection, reduce experimental trial-and-error, and support intelligent monitoring. The most promising direction is the integration of AI with in-mold sensing, simulation and closed-loop control for real-time compensation. However, broader adoption requires high-quality datasets, standardized benchmarks, robust cross-material generalization and interpretable models validated in factory conditions. We outline a research agenda to bridge laboratory demonstrations and scalable industrial implementation, positioning AI as an enabler of more robust, adaptive and sustainable MMIM.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】多材料注塑成型（MMIM）能够在单一组件中整合多种聚合物的特性，但其紧密耦合的热流变动力学和界面现象给工艺控制与质量保证带来了挑战。与此同时，人工智能（AI）和机器学习（ML）的进步通过预测建模、自适应优化和数据驱动控制正在重塑制造业。本文系统地总结了与MMIM相关的AI/ML方法以及优化和控制框架，区分了基于学习的预测模型与传统统计方法、基于替代模型的方法以及模拟辅助方法。在这些方法中，人工神经网络、径向基函数模型、遗传算法、混合智能优化和集成传感器的控制策略被应用于解决诸如焊缝线、缩痕、欠注、翘曲、烧痕和流痕等关键制造问题。2010年至2025年的研究证据表明，AI能够提高尺寸稳定性、缺陷预测能力并优化参数选择，减少实验中的试错次数，并支持智能监控。最具前景的发展方向是将AI与模具内传感技术、仿真技术和闭环控制相结合，以实现实时补偿。然而，要实现更广泛的应用，还需要高质量的数据集、标准化的评估指标、具备跨材料通用性的模型，以及在工厂条件下经过验证的、易于解释的模型。我们提出了一项研究计划，旨在将实验室成果转化为可扩展的工业应用，从而推动MMIM技术向更加稳健、自适应和可持续的...。研究方法：实验方法、机器学习、优化方法、数值模拟、神经网络。

papers.title: Anthropic Activity Markers 2.0: A Shift Towards Compositional Data Analysis
papers.venue: Journal of Archaeological Method and Theory
papers.abstract:
Abstract
                  
                    Anthropic Activity Markers (AAMs) were formalized over 10 years ago as a toolkit to infer human activities from biological and geochemical signatures preserved in sediments. This paper presents AAMs 2.0, a revised analytical framework that integrates compositional data analysis (CoDA) and geostatistics, as the appropriate statistical foundations for this approach. We first outline the theoretical motivation of this framework, demonstrating that treating geochemical concentrations as absolute values generates statistical artefacts that limit analytical reliability. Using the ethnoarchaeological dataset of Rondelli
                    et al
                    . (2014) as a test case, we illustrate how CoDA principles can be applied to revisit established interpretations. With this approach, we can identify meaningful compositional relationships without relying exclusively on heuristic element combinations, yielding results that are more statistically robust. Ultimately, AAMs 2.0 reframes activity markers as relational, ratio-based signals in space, providing a more rigorous foundation for archaeological inference.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】摘要

人类活动标记（Anthropic Activity Markers，AAMs）作为一种工具包，于10多年前被正式提出，旨在通过沉积物中保存的生物和地球化学特征来推断人类活动。本文介绍了AAMs 2.0——这一经过修订的分析框架，它将成分数据分析（Compositional Data Analysis，CoDA）与地统计学相结合，作为该方法的统计学基础。首先，我们阐述了这一框架的理论依据，指出将地球化学浓度视为绝对值会导致统计上的偏差，从而限制分析的可靠性。以Rondelli等人（2014年）的民族考古学数据集作为测试案例，我们展示了如何运用CoDA原理来重新审视现有的解释结果。通过这种方法，我们能够在不完全依赖经验性元素组合的情况下识别出有意义的成分关系，从而获得更具统计可靠性的结论。最终，AAMs 2.0将活动标记重新定义为基于空间关系的比率信号，为考古学推断提供了更为严谨的基础。。

papers.title: Assumption-Lean Shrinkage and Model Averaging for Spatial Parameters
papers.abstract: Economic decisions often depend on many noisy estimates of neighborhood effects, school quality, and hospital performance. Shrinkage estimation can reduce this noise by pooling information across related units. When units are related through geography, adjacency, or shared characteristics, the main challenge is not only how much to shrink, but which relationships should guide pooling. We use Stein's Unbiased Risk Estimate (SURE) to select among and average over flexible shrinkage estimators, allowing researchers to compare candidate definitions of relatedness without treating any one prior, covariance model, or adjacency rule as the true model for the latent parameters. Under regularity conditions stated directly on the estimator maps, SURE selection performs nearly as well as the best rule in a candidate class. The SURE-chosen weighted average likewise performs nearly as well as the best fixed weighted average of trained candidates, including nonlinear shrinkage rules whose fitted values use the full vector of noisy estimates. In an application to Opportunity Atlas economic mobility data from 20 commuting zones, the best individual spatial specification varies across zones, and the SURE-chosen average reduces reported SURE-estimated mean squared error by about 27% relative to the best-performing non-spatial empirical Bayes benchmark.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】经济决策往往依赖于许多关于邻里效应、学校质量和医院绩效的带有误差的估计值。通过整合相关单元的信息，收缩估计（shrinkage estimation）可以减少这些误差。当这些单元在地理位置、相邻关系或共同特征上存在关联时，主要挑战不仅在于收缩的程度，还在于应依据哪些关联关系来进行数据整合。我们采用斯坦因无偏风险估计量（Stein’s Unbiased Risk Estimate，简称SURE）来选择和平均多种灵活的收缩估计方法，使研究人员能够在不将任何特定的先验模型、协方差模型或邻接规则视为潜在参数真实模型的情况下，比较各种关联性的定义。在直接针对估计量映射提出的规则性条件下，SURE选择方法的表现几乎与候选方法中的最优方法相当。基于SURE选择的加权平均值同样也表现出色，其性能几乎可与训练有素的候选方法中的最优固定加权平均值相媲美，这些候选方法包括那些使用全部带有误差的估计值进行拟合的非线性收缩规则。在应用于20个通勤区域的经济流动性数据（来自“机会地图集”项目）时，最佳的空间模型因区域而异；与表现最佳的非空间经验贝叶斯（empirical Bayes）基准方法相比，基于SUR...。

papers.title: Rbreak: An R Package for Estimating Structural Breaks under Linear Restrictions with Application to Linear Model Tree
papers.abstract: The package \texttt{rbreak} implements methods for detecting structural breaks and estimating break locations for linear multiple regression models under general linear restrictions on the coefficient vector. Restrictions can be within regimes, across regimes, or both, and are supported in two forms: an affine parameterization (Form A: \texttt{delta = S*theta + s}) and explicit linear constraints (Form B: \texttt{R*delta = r}). It provides break date estimation with confidence interval, a restricted sup-F test for the null of no structural change, simulation of critical values by Monte Carlo, and a bootstrap restart procedure to reduce the risk of convergence to spurious local optima. It also implements a generalized regression tree (linear model tree) procedure where each leaf contains a linear regression rather than a local average. This note explains the methods and illustrates them with applications.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】软件包 \texttt{rbreak} 提供了用于检测线性多元回归模型中结构突变（breaks）并估计突变位置的方法，这些模型受到系数向量的一般线性约束。这些约束可以发生在同一数据区间内（regimes within）、不同数据区间之间（regimes across），或者同时存在于两者之间。该软件包支持两种约束形式：仿射参数化（形式 A：\texttt{delta = S*theta + s}）和显式线性约束（形式 B：\texttt{R*delta = r}）。它能够生成带有置信区间的突变日期估计结果，对“无结构变化”这一零假设进行受限的 sup-F 检验，通过蒙特卡洛方法模拟临界值，并通过自举重启（bootstrap restart）程序降低收敛到虚假局部最优解的风险。此外，该软件包还实现了一种广义回归树（generalized regression tree，即线性模型树）算法，其中每个叶子节点包含的是线性回归模型而非局部平均值。本文详细解释了这些方法，并通过具体应用实例进行了说明。。研究方法：回归分析、蒙特卡洛模拟、数值模拟。

papers.title: WAYS TO IMPROVE INSTITUTIONAL REGULATIONS OF INNOVATIVE ECONOMY TRANSFORMATIONS
papers.abstract: Innovative transformations of the economy require the availability of financial and non-financial resources, as well as state support. In this regard, the institutional regulations of innovative transformations are important, which are not yet systemic in the Republic of Armenia, and therefore operate ineffectively. The article proposes to develop a concept of innovative transformation of the economy, taking as its main pillars the provision of financial privileges, increasing economic competitiveness and ensuring resources for the introduction of innovations. At the same time, the key goal of the proposed concept is to increase the living standards of the population as a result of innovative transformations of the economy. The research was supported by the Higher Education and Science Committee of MESCS RA (Research project № 25AA-5B029).
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】经济的创新转型需要金融和非金融资源的支持，以及政府的扶持。在这方面，创新转型的制度规范至关重要，但在亚美尼亚共和国，这些规范尚未形成系统化的体系，因此其实施效果不佳。本文提出了一种经济创新转型的概念，该概念以提供金融优惠、提升经济竞争力以及确保创新所需的资源为核心要素。其根本目标是通过经济的创新转型来提高人民的生活水平。本研究得到了亚美尼亚共和国教育和科学部高等教育与科学委员会的支持（研究项目编号：25AA-5B029）。。

papers.title:
How Does
 AI
 Empower Corporate
 ESG
 Practices? Mechanisms Based on Information Processing Theory
papers.abstract: In the context of the latest technological revolution and industrial transformation, Artificial Intelligence (AI) provides new impetus for the development of corporate ESG practices. This study, based on data from 2630 A‐share listed companies in China from 2010 to 2022, examines the impact of AI on corporate ESG performance and its mechanisms of action and explores the moderating effects of capital market financing environment. The results reveal that AI can notably enhance the ESG performance of listed companies in China. This finding is proven robust after robustness tests, including machine learning models. Based on information processing theory, the study further constructs a framework for mechanism analysis across the environmental, social, and governance dimensions. The results show that AI enhances corporate ESG performance through three channels: improving green innovation rate, enhancing price markup capabilities, and reducing agency costs. Heterogeneity analysis reveals that the enabling effects of AI on corporate ESG performance are more pronounced for technology‐intensive firms, non‐highly polluting firms, and firms in highly competitive industries. Further research suggests that optimization of the external capital market financing environment facilitates the empowering effect of AI on corporate ESG performance. This study provides practical insights for enterprises to effectively advance sustainable development through “AI+ ESG”, for regulatory bodies to refine sustainable governance systems, and for capital markets to innovate in financial services for technology.
papers.summary_zh:
📌 研究问题：AI如何影响企业ESG表现？其具体的作用机制是什么？外部资本市场的融资环境在其中扮演何种调节角色？

🔬 研究方法：基于2010至2022年中国2630家A股上市公司的数据，结合信息处理理论构建分析框架，并进行了异质性分析和调节效应检验。

📊 核心发现：研究发现AI显著提升企业ESG表现，主要通过提高绿色创新率、增强价格加成能力和降低代理成本三个渠道实现；且该效应在技术密集型、非高污染及竞争激烈的行业中更为显著，良好的外部融资环境能进一步强化这一赋能作用。

💡 应用价值：为企业在“AI+ESG”框架下实现可持续发展提供了实践指导，同时也为监管机构完善可持续治理体系及资本市场创新金融服务提供了政策参考。

papers.title: Market Design for AI: Beyond the Copyright Binary
papers.abstract: How can we design a market of human-generated content for use in training AI models that both enables technological progress and preserves individual incentives for high-quality content creation? Existing approaches take polar positions: a "free-for-all" model based on fair use and a "strong intellectual property rights" model. We show that both fail: Free-for-all does not compensate creators, and -- by modeling as a static Stackelberg game -- strong intellectual property rights also underpower creative incentives. We find this especially true for more innovative creators, a phenomenon we term the "originality penalty." Extending this insight to a dynamic model, we find another market failure undermining AI model performance, even for an initially good model: Such a model induces greater reliance by humans on AI-assisted creation, resulting in homogenized content feeding back into training, which degrades the model performance -- a "curse of precision." We further propose a market design with a data intermediary internalizing cross-creator externalities and subsidizing innovative contributions, thereby restoring efficiency.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们如何设计一个由人类生成的内容市场，以便用于训练人工智能模型？这个市场既要推动技术进步，又要保持创作者创作高质量内容的积极性？现有的方法通常处于两个极端：一种是基于“合理使用”原则的“自由竞争”模式，另一种是强调“严格知识产权保护”的模式。我们发现这两种方法都存在问题：自由竞争模式无法对创作者进行有效补偿；而将这种竞争关系建模为静态的斯塔克伯格博弈（Stackelberg game）后，严格的知识产权保护反而会削弱创作者的创作动力。这一现象在更具创新性的创作者身上尤为明显，我们将其称为“原创性惩罚”（originality penalty）。将这一见解扩展到动态模型中，我们发现另一个市场失灵现象正在损害人工智能模型的性能——即使模型本身最初表现良好，这种失灵也会导致人类更加依赖人工智能辅助创作，进而产生同质化的内容，这些内容反过来又会降低模型的训练效果，形成所谓的“精确度的诅咒”（curse of precision）。为此，我们提出了一种新的市场设计方案：通过数据中介来内部化不同创作者之间的外部性，并对创新性贡献提供补贴，从而恢复市场的效率。。

papers.title: Materealistic? How European energy system models exceed raw material reserves
papers.abstract: Decarbonising energy systems reduces emissions and fossil fuel dependency, but expanding renewables increases demands for critical raw materials. Most energy system models, however, neglect material demands, putting the material feasibility of energy scenarios at question. We combine a systematic review of 59 highly decarbonised European energy system modelling studies with a quantitative ex-post assessment of material demands for 5 key technologies and 19 materials. We find that material demands exceed Europe's population-based shares of current global reserves for seven materials (Ga, In, Ir, Te; less pronounced for Ag, Se, V), in particular if multiple sectors of the energy system are considered. Competing non-energy demand further amplifies the scarcity, while technological innovation can either alleviate or intensify it. We conclude that energy efficiency, recycling, expanding reserves and technological innovation may only partly address the identified shortages and call for energy sufficiency measures to achieve sustainability in the energy-material nexus.
papers.summary_zh:
📌 研究问题：减碳虽然降低化石燃料依赖，但会增加关键原材料需求，而大多数能源系统模型往往忽视了这一因素，导致能源场景的材料可行性存疑。

🔬 研究方法：研究结合了对59项高度脱碳的欧洲能源系统建模研究的系统综述，以及对5项关键技术和19种材料需求的定量后评估。

📊 核心发现：研究发现，在考虑能源系统多个部门时，七种关键材料（如镓、铟、铱、碲）的需求超过了欧洲基于人口的全球储量份额，且非能源需求进一步加剧了这种稀缺性。

💡 应用价值：研究表明，仅靠能源效率、回收利用和扩大储量等措施不足以解决短缺问题，必须实施能源充足性措施才能实现能源与材料的可持续性。

papers.title: Pivotal and identification-robust nonparametric inference in linear IV models
papers.abstract: We develop new inference procedures for a linear IV model that are robust to identification strength and heteroskedasticity of unknown form, and nonparametric with respect to the first-stage equation. Our first test is tailored for inference on parameters of endogenous explanatory variables. Our new statistic modifies that of Antoine and Lavergne (2003) to directly account for heteroskedasticity of unknown form. As a result, it is asymptotically pivotal, so that inference is greatly facilitated in practice. We also develop (i) an identification-robust subvector inference procedure that does not rely on the knowledge of identification strength for the remaining parameters, and (ii) a pure specification test. In both cases, the tests are conservative but powerful. We show that our procedures are computationally friendly and competitive with existing ones in simulations and an application.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们为线性工具变量（IV）模型开发了新的推断方法，这些方法对识别强度和未知形式的异方差性具有鲁棒性，并且对第一阶段方程的参数是非参数化的。我们的第一个检验专门用于推断内生解释变量的参数。我们新的统计量改进了Antoine和Lavergne（2003）提出的方法，能够直接考虑未知形式的异方差性。因此，该统计量在渐近意义上具有关键性，从而在实际应用中大大简化了推断过程。我们还开发了：（i）一种不依赖于剩余参数识别强度信息的、具有识别鲁棒性的子向量推断方法；（ii）一种纯粹的模型设定检验方法。在这两种情况下，这些检验方法虽然较为保守，但依然具有很强的检验能力。我们通过模拟和实际应用证明了，我们的方法在计算上易于实现，并且与现有的方法具有竞争力。。研究方法：数值模拟。

papers.title: Threshold Regression for Fixed-T Panel Data with Interactive Fixed Effects
papers.abstract: This paper develops a new toolbox for estimation and inference in panel data threshold regression models with interactive fixed effects and a fixed number of time periods, T. The toolbox is designed to be simple, accurate and computationally efficient. It is based on a simple least squares style estimator of the model parameters, and includes a number of inferential procedures for testing hypotheses regarding not only the threshold but also other parameters. The new toolbox is applied to study the impact of inflation on economic growth.
papers.summary_zh:
📌 研究问题：本文旨在解决具有交互固定效应和固定时间跨度（T）的面板数据阈值回归模型的估计与推断问题。

🔬 研究方法：本文开发了一套新的工具箱，基于简单的最小二乘风格估计量，并包含针对阈值及其他参数假设检验的多种推断程序。

📊 核心发现：该工具箱具有简单、准确和计算高效的特点，并被应用于研究通胀对经济增长的影响。

💡 应用价值：该工具箱为面板数据阈值回归提供了简单、准确且高效的估计与推断手段，为分析通胀对经济增长的影响提供了新方法。

papers.title: Schedules and Prioritization: A Behavioral Foundation for Multi-Armed Bandits and Stopping Problems
papers.abstract: Bandit models typically begin with arms, states, rewards, and transition rules. This paper instead begins with preferences over stopped local contingent schedules: possible unfoldings of a responsibility, project, experiment, or opportunity in its own local time. Behavioral axioms on single schedules characterize a generalized stopping representation with current utility, local discounting, and a broad continuation aggregator. A common-tail compensation axiom then allows calendar time to be priced across schedules. Imposing a tight elapsed-calendar constraint generates a rested generalized bandit and yields index optimality: the index is the shadow price of advancing a local clock. Expected-utility, learning, robust, rank-dependent, Choquet, and Pandora models arise as special cases.
papers.summary_zh: 【行为金融】盗贼模型（Bandit models）通常以“臂”（arms，指可供选择的行动方案）、“状态”（states）、“奖励”（rewards）以及“转移规则”（transition rules）为基本构成要素。然而，本文的出发点是人们对“停止后的局部条件性时间表”（stopped local contingent schedules）的偏好——这些时间表描述了责任、项目、实验或机会在各自局部时间内的可能发展过程。基于单个时间表的行为公理（behavioral axioms）构建了一种通用的停止表示模型，该模型包含了当前效用（current utility）、局部折现（local discounting）以及一个用于整合后续事件的机制（continuation aggregator）。随后引入的“共同尾部补偿公理”（common-tail compensation axiom）使得不同时间表上的日历时间能够被赋予相应的价值。通过施加严格的日历时间流逝约束（tight elapsed-calendar constraint），可以构建出一个“休息状态下的通用盗贼模型”（rested ge...。研究方法：实验方法。

papers.title: Composite likelihood inference of fractional Gaussian processes with sequentially optimal subset selection
papers.abstract: The composite likelihood method reduces the computational cost of parameter estimation in time series by considering several subsets of observations instead of all observations at once. The asymptotic properties of this method are related to the Godambe information, an extension of the Fisher information that accounts for the dependence between subsets of observations. We aim to apply this method to linear Gaussian models, in particular fractional Brownian motion and fractional Gaussian noise. We derive theoretical expressions for their Fisher information and their Godambe information and deduce a subset selection design that sequentially maximizes the Godambe information. The size of the subsets then allows us to control the trade-off between estimation accuracy and computational cost. Through simulations, we compare this method with the method of moments and maximum likelihood estimation, and we apply it to real data, namely volatility series of a stock index and a wind speed time series.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】复合似然方法通过仅考虑部分观测数据而非全部观测数据，降低了时间序列参数估计的计算成本。该方法的渐近性质与Godambe信息有关，Godambe信息是Fisher信息的扩展形式，用于表征不同观测数据子集之间的依赖性。我们计划将这种方法应用于线性高斯模型，特别是分数布朗运动和分数高斯噪声模型。我们推导了这些模型的Fisher信息与Godambe信息的理论表达式，并设计了一种能够依次最大化Godambe信息的子集选择方法。通过调整子集的大小，我们可以控制估计精度与计算成本之间的权衡。通过仿真实验，我们将该方法与矩估计法和最大似然估计法进行了比较，并将其应用于实际数据，包括股票指数的波动率序列和风速时间序列。。研究方法：时间序列、数值模拟。
